name: Assistant chat
description: The main conversational agent. It answers in Markdown, shows tool activity, handles attachments, and saves local session history.
highlights: Markdown, code blocks, and inline images

name: Agent tools
description: The action surface Kucedr uses to read and write files, run commands, search or browse the web, generate images, schedule work, load skills, and call MCP tools.
highlights: File, shell, web, browser, image, schedule, skill, subagent, and MCP tools

name: Voice
description: Dictate prompts with speech-to-text and have Kucedr read replies aloud with the voice provider and model you choose.

name: Image generation
description: Create images from text descriptions in chat or a dedicated image workspace.
highlights: Available as a chat tool and settings workspace

name: Skills
description: Reusable packaged workflows that teach Kucedr how to handle a class of work.
highlights: Install, import, enable, and disable skills

name: MCP servers
description: Connect remote HTTP or local stdio Model Context Protocol servers so their tools become available to the assistant.
highlights: HTTP servers with optional token or key auth

name: Channels
description: Talk to Kucedr from Telegram and Discord today and receive replies back through the same channel. Slack, WhatsApp, and Email are planned adapters.
highlights: Allowlist, pairing, open, or deny DM policy
Separate channel secrets and enabled state

name: Task scheduler
description: Create recurring assistant jobs such as summaries, checks, and routine cleanup tasks.
highlights: Create, update, pause, resume, list, and run schedules
Each schedule runs an agent turn
Provider and model selection for scheduled work

name: Health checks
description: Run Kucedr periodically against a checklist you define and report back when something needs attention.

name: Memory and personalization
description: Durable facts, preferences, identity, and workspace context help Kucedr respond with useful personal context.

name: Video and audio generation
description: Generate video, music, and sound effects from text with the provider and model you choose. Results are playable inline and saved to your local media library.
highlights: Text-to-video with your chosen provider and model
Separate provider and model choices per media type
Saved to the local media library and playable in chat
